julia.ae: Heads-up — during legal review customer.securecorp just dropped a new network requirement: all traffic must egress through their corporate proxy in region eu-west-1 and terminate to a private IP we can't reach from hosted mode. They want this enforced for the POC.
kevin.se: Oof. That changes the plan — hosted API won't work unless we do a proxy hop or they open a path. Any SLA implications?
anita.sec: From security's POV, BYO egress/KMS looks necessary. They'll expect audit logs + no internet egress from model nodes.
tim.sales_eng: Customer is pushing for 2-week POC start next Mon. If we need Private (VPC) or Dedicated with VPC peering, that'll add setup time and a contract change.
julia.ae: Can we scope a minimal workaround to keep timeline? Maybe a temporary VPN or bastion?
kevin.se: Two options: 1) Redwood Private in their VPC (full isolation) — ~3-5 business days infra setup + infra eng lead; costs increase, needs ent contract. 2) Hosted + streaming proxy in their account that forwards to us (still needs egress rules and certs) — faster but has security signoff risk.
olivia.prod: Also consider partial functionality: run embeddings/rerank hosted (no customer data) and run LLM inference in Private for PII paths. Hybrid increases orchestration complexity.
anita.sec: Hybrid acceptable if we enforce data routing: prompts with customer_data tag go to Private. Need a prompt filter and audit.
julia.ae: Customer asked what success looks like — they want latency <200ms median for short queries, throughput 50 QPS, and red-teamed PII protection on responses. Can we promise that on Private?
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: new ticket created #POC-4938 for Private infra prep
kevin.se: Latency for Private in eu-west-1 with our optimized runtime should meet 200ms median for seq len 128 if we pin model variant and use batching config. Throughput 50 QPS needs reserved capacity (Dedicated pool sizing).
tim.sales_eng: Pricing note: Dedicated reserve for 50 QPS ~~ $Xk/mo (ballpark), Private one-time setup & infra ops fee Yk. Need to get exact numbers from finance.
julia.ae: Action items: Kevin run feasibility + estimate (infra + time), Anita write minimal security checklist for hybrid fallback, Tim prep draft pricing delta and contract note, Olivia propose acceptance test harness for latency & PII evals.
kevin.se: I'll spin up a quick checklist. If we do Private, ETA 4 business days for infra + 1 day for cert/key exchange if customer provides KMS endpoint.
anita.sec: Checklist (short): 1) VPC peering or transit gateway configured; 2) Customer-managed egress IPs allow; 3) BYO KMS via HSM endpoint or sealed envelope for keys; 4) Audit/log shipping to their S3/ELK; 5) No public endpoints.
julia.ae: Customer asked about fallback if setup slips — can we offer a read-only demo using sanitized transcripts via hosted that shows model behavior while infra finishes?
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: note added to #POC-4938 - "sanitized demo"
olivia.prod: Yes, we can create a sanitized prompt set and a mock UI for the demo. That covers acceptance criteria for UX while infra catches up.
tim.sales_eng: I'll communicate to the customer: propose split plan — immediate sanitized demo (hosted) within 3 days, full POC in Private/Dedicated in 7-10 business days. Include pricing delta and optional canary rollback plan.
julia.ae: Thanks — please post estimates in this thread. Also customer wants an answer on contract change (SLA/commit) by EOD tomorrow.
kevin.se: Estimate posted: infra setup 4 days, keys exchange 1 day, dedicated sizing ops 2 days. Ops effort ~3 engineer-days. Will attach config snippet and required ports.
kevin.se: ```
Required ports: 443 outbound to customer proxy
VPC peering: cidr 10.10.0.0/16
KMS: customer endpoint TLS cert + jwk
Model pin: r-instruct-v2-quant
Batching: continuous batching ON, max_batch_ms=20
```
anita.sec: I'll send a short Q for customer about their KMS (HSM vs cloud KMS) and whether they can provide a static egress IP for allowlisting.
julia.ae: OK — if we can get the static IP and KMS details today, we can keep the original timeline. Otherwise, escalate to enterprise ops for faster provisioning.
kevin.se: Noted. I'll follow up with ops and tag eng-oncall if ports need special routing.
